intro.title: What is se-vezmou.cz?
intro.lead: Se-vezmou.cz is a Czech service for building wedding websites. Couples put their site together from ready-made templates, and guests find the schedule, venue and accommodation and reply without signing up.
intro.more: Every couple gets an address like first-name-and-first-name.se-vezmou.cz. It reads like a sentence, so it looks good on an invitation and is easy to remember.
intro.formLabel: Try out what your address will look like
problem.title: Guests keep asking the same things. Your website answers for you.
problem.lead: Most messages before a wedding are about the same few questions: where to go, when it starts and what to wear. A wedding website answers them before your guests have to ask.
problem.q1.title: Where am I going?
problem.q1.text: The address, map, parking and transport in one place, with a single tap into satnav.
problem.q2.title: What time does it start?
problem.q2.text: The schedule hour by hour. If anything changes, you update it and everyone sees the latest version.
problem.q3.title: What do I wear and where do I sleep?
problem.q3.text: The dress code, accommodation tips and RSVPs with dietary needs, all on the website.

trust.title: Private and accessible from the very first click
trust.lead: Couples’ websites do not appear in search engines, and sensitive details are shown to guests only after they enter a PIN. We design every site so that anyone can read it.
trust.hidden.title: Hidden from search engines
trust.hidden.text: Neither Google nor a random visitor will find your website. Switched on from the start.

trust.accessible.title: Readable by everyone
trust.accessible.text: We follow the WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility rules: contrast, large targets, screen readers and no account for guests.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Cannot find your answer? Write to us: {contact}.
faq.1.a: During the launch period, creating and publishing your website costs 0 CZK. Publishing will be charged for later; we will announce the price and the terms for websites published during the launch period in advance.
faq.2.q: Do guests need an account or an app?
faq.2.a: No. The website opens in any ordinary browser at your address, and guests reply without signing up.
faq.3.q: Will my website show up on Google?
faq.3.a: No. Couples’ websites are blocked from indexing, so search engines do not list them. Only people you send the address to will find them, and you can put sensitive details behind a PIN.
faq.4.q: How do I sign in to manage my website?
faq.4.a: With your email: we send you a one-time code, so there is no password to remember. You can also set up a PIN. Guests never sign in at all.
faq.5.q: Can I save my website and publish it later?
faq.5.a: Yes. It can stay as a draft with a private preview link, and you publish it whenever you are ready.
faq.6.q: What happens to my guests’ details?
faq.6.a: Only you, as the wedding’s organiser, can see your guests’ replies, and we store them only to help you run the wedding. We will publish the privacy policy, including how long we keep data, before the full launch.

about.p2: Photos are part of a wedding, so the website comes with two more projects of mine.
